title: Restoration Vendor Turnaround by Format
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:photo format_type=* submitted_epoch=* returned_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((returned_epoch-submitted_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by format_type
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures vendor turnaround by format type for restoration vendors.
value: Lag tracking shows which format type create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside restoration vendors.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `vendor turnaround` on `genealogy:photo` events and aggregate them by `format_type`.
visualization: Table of format type with average and worst vendor turnaround.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how long things take for each format type so you can see where restoration vendors slows down.
